title: O Friend, lead me on
lead: The historic first song of Prabhat Samgiita, opening the entire collection with a devotional call of the soul to the True Friend. Important for the student are the compound verb of motion niye calo ("take and lead") and the reduplication gáne gáne ("song after song").

words.etymology: Skt. बन्धु (bandhu) - relative, friend; from the root बन्ध् (bandh) - to bind

words.role: predicate (main verb of compound motion niye calo)
words.meaning_here: lead, guide, carry away with You

lines.structure: address (bandhu he) + compound verb of motion (niye calo = take and go / lead)
lines.natural: O dearest Friend, lead me on!

words.meaning_here: toward the flowing stream of the spring/waterfall

lines.structure: adverbial of direction (alor oi jharna-dharar pane), modifies the predicate niye calo
lines.literal: Of light of that stream-waterfall toward
lines.natural: Lead me unto that fountain of effulgence!

lines.structure: repetition of the refrain line (address + predicate)
lines.natural: O dearest Friend, lead me on!

words.form: adverb of time with negation (no longer)

words.meaning_here: in the soul, in the life-force

lines.structure: subject (andharer vyatha) + adverbial of time (ar) + locative (prane) + predicate with negation (say na)
lines.literal: Of darkness the pain longer is borne not in the heart
lines.natural: I can no longer bear the pain of darkness in my heart.

lines.structure: repetition of the refrain line (address + predicate)
lines.natural: O dearest Friend, lead me on!

words.form: nominative/accusative case, sing. (direct object of the verbal noun bhanganor)
repetition of noun in instrumental/locative case (reduplication: song after song)
words.meaning_here: with each new song, with unceasing songs

lines.structure: adverbial of means/manner: attribute (ghumer ghor bhanganor) + reduplication (gane gane), modifies niye calo
lines.literal: Of sleep stupor breaking with songs-songs
lines.natural: With Your songs, break the deep slumber of sleep and lead me on!

lines.structure: repetition of the refrain line (address + predicate)
lines.natural: O dearest Friend, lead me on!

heard: In the video captions, it is written 'A'lor oi jharan'a' dha'ra'ra pa'ne' (separating jharna and dharar)
In line 3, the captions show 'A'ndha'rer vyatha' a'r saye na' pra'n'e' (with the verb form saye instead of say, although the standard shoy is sung)
In line 5, the captions show 'Bha'm'ga'nor' with anusvara, pronounced bhanganor
interpretation: The first song of the Prabhat Samgiita collection expresses the primordial call of the jiiva to the Supreme Entity (Parama Puruśa). The spiritual aspirant recognizes the burden of staticity and ignorance (darkness) and implores the Divine Friend to awaken them from the sleep of maya through the melodies of songs and lead them away toward the eternal source of spiritual light.
